newsitem.title: USA: Stocks jump; buoyed by falling oil prices, economic data.
newsitem.headline: Stocks jump; buoyed by falling oil prices, economic data.

text.p: Stocks closed on a strong note Thursday as a sharp drop in crude oil prices and more positive news about the economy sent long-term interest rates to their lowest levels in nearly 7 months.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 36.15 points at 6,029.38. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines 14-9 on heavy volume of 485 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
The yield on the 30-year Treasury bond fell to 6.65 percent -- its lowest level since April 3 -- from 6.71 percent on Wednesday.
